blurb:
Private 2-Hour Key West Sunset Cruise | Luxury Manitou Pontoon | Up to 10 Guests

Leave the crowds behind and experience the magic of a Key West sunset from the water on your own private 2-hour cruise aboard a brand-new Manitou luxury pontoon. Departing from the tranquil Cow Key Channel, you'll enjoy a relaxed and intimate journey through hidden backchannels and open waters — all with a front-row seat to one of nature’s most unforgettable shows.

Cruise in comfort with up to 10 guests, guided by a licensed local captain, and take in stunning views of the sunset-drenched coastline, including iconic sights near Mallory Square — without ever getting caught in the crowd.

Whether you're planning a romantic evening, a family outing, or a fun get-together with friends, this cruise offers the perfect mix of laid-back luxury and scenic beauty.

Reserve your sunset escape now — and experience Key West the way locals love it: peaceful, personal, and absolutely stunning.
